translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the ninth month, the sun was red and gave no light.

sentences.zh: 二年三月甲午，日中有黑氣如柸。

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the third month of the second year, within the sun was black vapor shaped like a bowl.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，日中有黑子。

translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the second month of year 2 of Dahe, the sun gave no light; white fog made day as dark as dusk.

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year, a black cloud-banner contended with the sun as in combat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year, a black cloud-banner contended with the sun as in combat.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: On yichou in the fourth month, black vapor ground against the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the fourth month, black vapor ground against the sun.

sentences.zh: 七年正月庚戌，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On gengxu in the first month of the seventh year, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the first month of the seventh year, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 八年七月甲戌，白虹貫日，日有交暈。

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the seventh month of the eighth year, a white rainbow pierced the sun, and the sun bore crossed halos.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the seventh month of the eighth year, a white rainbow pierced the sun, and the sun bore crossed halos.

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the new moon of the first month of year 1 of Kaicheng, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，亦如之。

translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the second month, it was likewise.

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the eleventh month of the second year, within the sun was a black spot as large as a hen's egg; the sun was red as ochre, and day was as dark as dusk until guiwei.

sentences.zh: 五年正月己丑，日暈，白虹在東，如玉環貫珥。

translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the first month of the fifth year, the sun showed a halo; a white rainbow in the east pierced it like a jade ring through ear-rings.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，日有重暈，有赤氣夾日。

translations.literal: On bingchen in the second month, the sun bore a double halo with crimson vapor flanking it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the second month, the sun bore a double halo with crimson vapor flanking it.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，日旁有黑氣來觸。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the twelfth month, day guimao, beside the sun black vapor came and touched it.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the new moon of the twelfth month, black vapor came beside the sun and touched it.

sentences.zh: 會昌元年十一月庚戌，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: On gengxu in the eleventh month of the first year of Huichang, within the sun was a black spot.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the eleventh month of year 1 of Huichang, within the sun was a black spot.

sentences.zh: 四年正月戊申，日無光。

translations.literal: On wushen in the first month of the fourth year, the sun shed no light.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the first month of the fourth year, the sun gave no light.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，白虹貫日如玉環。

translations.literal: On jisi in the second month, a white rainbow pierced the sun like a jade ring.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the second month, a white rainbow pierced the sun like a jade ring.

sentences.zh: 大中十三年四月甲午，日暗無光。

translations.literal: On jiawu in the fourth month of the thirteenth year of Dazhong, the sun was dim and shed no light.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the fourth month of year 13 of Dazhong, the sun was dim and gave no light.

sentences.zh: 咸通六年正月，白虹貫日，中有黑氣如雞卵。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year of Xiantong, a white rainbow pierced the sun; within it was black vapor like a hen's egg.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 6 of Xiantong, a white rainbow pierced the sun; within it was black vapor like a hen's egg.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月癸酉，白氣貫日，日有重暈。

translations.literal: On guiyou in the twelfth month of the seventh year, white vapor pierced the sun, and the sun bore a double halo.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the twelfth month of the seventh year, white vapor pierced the sun, and the sun bore a double halo.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，亦如之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, it was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, it was likewise.

sentences.zh: 白氣，兵象也。

translations.literal: White vapor is an omen of warfare.
translations.idiomatic: White vapor is an omen of warfare.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月癸卯，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On guimao in the second month of the fourteenth year, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the second month of the fourteenth year, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 乾符元年，日中有黑子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianfu, within the sun was a black spot.
translations.idiomatic: In year 1 of Qianfu, within the sun was a black spot.

sentences.zh: 二年，日中有若飛燕者。

translations.literal: In the second year, within the sun was something like a flying swallow.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, within the sun was something like a flying swallow.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月丙辰朔，有兩日並出而鬬，三日乃不見。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the new moon of the eleventh month of the sixth year, two suns appeared together and contended; after three days they were no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the new moon of the eleventh month of the sixth year, two suns rose together and contended; after three days they vanished.

sentences.zh: 鬬者，離而復合也。

translations.literal: "Contending" means separation followed by reunion.
translations.idiomatic: Contending means separation followed by reunion.

sentences.zh: 廣明元年，日暈如虹，黃氣蔽日無光。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangming, the sun showed a halo like a rainbow; yellow vapor veiled the sun and it shed no light.
translations.idiomatic: In year 1 of Guangming, the sun showed a rainbow-like halo; yellow vapor veiled the sun and it gave no light.

sentences.zh: 日不可以二；

translations.literal: There cannot be two suns;
translations.idiomatic: There cannot be two suns;

translations.literal: the rainbow is the root of a hundred calamities.
translations.idiomatic: the rainbow is the root of a hundred calamities.

translations.literal: On bingwu in the third month of the third year of Zhonghe, the sun bore azure and yellow halos.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi and wuwu, it was again likewise.

sentences.zh: 光啟三年十一月己亥，下晡，日上有黑氣。

translations.literal: On jihai in the eleventh month of the third year of Guangqi, in the late afternoon, above the sun was black vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eleventh month of year 3 of Guangqi, in the late afternoon, black vapor stood above the sun.

sentences.zh: 四年二月己丑，日赤如血。

translations.literal: On jichou in the second month of the fourth year, the sun was red as blood.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the second month of the fourth year, the sun was red as blood.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，改元文德。

translations.literal: On gengyin the era name was changed to Wende.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the era name was changed to Wende.

sentences.zh: 是日，風，日赤無光。

translations.literal: That day the wind blew; the sun was red and shed no light.
translations.idiomatic: That day the wind blew; the sun was red and gave no light.

sentences.zh: 景福元年五月，日色散如黃金。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Jingfu, the sun's color scattered like gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 1 of Jingfu, the sun's color scattered like gold.

sentences.zh: 光化三年冬，日有虹蜺背璚彌旬，日有赤氣，自東北至于東南。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year of Guanghua, the sun bore rainbow halos with backing arcs for more than ten days; crimson vapor ran from the northeast to the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of year 3 of Guanghua, the sun bore rainbow halos with backing arcs for more than ten days; crimson vapor ran from the northeast to the southeast.

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Tianfu, the sun's color scattered like gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 1 of Tianfu, the sun's color scattered like gold.

sentences.zh: 十一月，又如之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, it was again likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, it was again likewise.

translations.literal: On dingchou in the third month of the third year, the sun bore crimson vapor from the northeast to the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the third month of the third year, crimson vapor ran from the northeast to the southeast along the sun.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年二月丙寅，日中見北斗，其占重。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the second month of the first year of Tianyou, the Northern Dipper was seen within the sun — a grave omen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the second month of year 1 of Tianyou, the Northern Dipper was seen within the sun — a grave omen.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，日中，日有黃暈，旁有青赤氣二。

translations.literal: On guiyou in the eleventh month, at midday the sun bore a yellow halo with two flanking bands of azure and crimson vapor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the eleventh month, at midday the sun bore a yellow halo with two flanking bands of azure and crimson vapor.

sentences.zh: 二年正月甲申，日有黃白暈，暈上有青赤背。

translations.literal: On jiashen in the first month of the second year, the sun bore yellow-white halos; atop the halo were azure-crimson backing arcs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the first month of the second year, the sun bore yellow-white halos with azure-crimson backing arcs above.

translations.literal: On yiyou it was again likewise; within the halo a white rainbow grew toward the east, more than a hundred zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou it was again likewise; within the halo a white rainbow grew eastward, more than a hundred zhang long.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，日有黃白暈如半環，有蒼黑雲夾日，長各六尺餘，既而雲變，狀如人如馬，乃消。

translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the second month, the sun bore yellow-white halos like a half-ring; dark azure clouds flanked the sun, each more than six chi long; then the clouds shifted into shapes like men and horses and dissolved.

translations.literal: Old prognostications say: "Backing arcs are a sign of rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: Old prognostications say: "Backing arcs are a sign of rebellion."

translations.literal: When the sun's halo has a rainbow, great war follows; a half-halo means mutual plotting.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun's halo has a rainbow, great war follows; a half-halo means mutual plotting.

translations.idiomatic: Dark azure is an omen of sinister fortune.

translations.literal: Clouds flanking the sun are a sign of rebellious ministers controlling the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds flanking the sun are a sign of rebellious ministers controlling the ruler.

sentences.zh: 變而如人者為叛臣；

translations.literal: When they change into human shapes, rebellious ministers are meant;

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the first month of the third year, the sun bore yellow-white halos with azure-crimson backing arcs above.

translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the sun bore yellow-white halos with azure-crimson backing arcs.

sentences.zh: 月變貞觀初，突厥有三月並見。

translations.literal: Lunar anomalies — At the beginning of Zhenguan, among the Turks three moons appeared together.
translations.idiomatic: Lunar anomalies — Early in Zhenguan, the Turks reported three moons appearing at once.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳二年正月甲子朔，月見西方，是謂朓。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the new moon of the first month of the second year of Yifeng, the moon was seen in the west — this is called a late waning.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the new moon of the first month of year 2 of Yifeng, the moon was seen in the west — this is called a late waning.

sentences.zh: 朓則侯王其舒。

translations.literal: When the moon wanes late, feudal lords grow lax.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon wanes late, feudal lords grow lax.

sentences.zh: 武太后時，月過望不虧者二。

translations.literal: Under Empress Wu, twice the moon passed full without waning.
translations.idiomatic: Under Empress Wu, twice the moon passed full without waning.

sentences.zh: 天寶三載正月庚戌，月有紅氣如垂帶。

translations.literal: On gengxu in the first month of the third year of Tianbao, the moon bore crimson vapor like a hanging sash.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the first month of year 3 of Tianbao, the moon bore crimson vapor like a hanging sash.

translations.literal: On guisi in the yizi month of the first year of Suzong, in the second watch the moon occulted the Hairy Head and showed a halo; the color was white, and white vapor from the north pierced it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the yizi month of year 1 of Suzong, in the second watch the moon occulted the Hairy Head and showed a halo; it was white, and white vapor from the north pierced it.

sentences.zh: 昴，胡也。

translations.literal: The Hairy Head governs the Hu.
translations.idiomatic: The Hairy Head lodge governs the Hu peoples.

translations.literal: White vapor means warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: White vapor means warfare and mourning.

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the jichen month, the moon bore a yellow-white crown with linked halos encircling the Eastern Well, the Five Feudal Lords, the Two Rivers, and the Ghost Carriage.

translations.literal: The Eastern Well is the allotment of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Well lodge is the capital-region allotment.

sentences.zh: 元和十一年，己未旦，日已出，有虹貫月于營室。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yuanhe, on jiwei at dawn, the sun had already risen when a rainbow pierced the moon in the Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 of Yuanhe, on jiwei at dawn, the sun had already risen when a rainbow pierced the moon in the Encampment lodge.

sentences.zh: 開成四年閏正月甲申朔，乙酉，月在營室，在偃魄質成，早也。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the intercalary first month of the fourth year of Kaicheng, day jiashen, on yiyou the moon was in the Encampment, in the quality of the waning spirit at completion — early.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the intercalary first month's new moon of year 4 of Kaicheng, on yiyou the moon was in the Encampment at the waning-spirit quality of completion — too early.

sentences.zh: 占為臣下專恣之象。

translations.literal: The prognostication is a sign of ministers acting willfully.
translations.idiomatic: The omen prognosticated ministers acting willfully.

sentences.zh: 五年正月戊寅朔，甲申，月昏而中，未弦而中，早也。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the first month of the fifth year, day wuyin, on jiashen the moon culminated while still dark, and culminated before the first quarter — early.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the first month's new moon of the fifth year, on jiashen the moon culminated while still dark and before the first quarter — too early.

sentences.zh: 占同上。

translations.literal: The prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omen is the same as above.

sentences.zh: 景福二年十一月，有白氣如環，貫月，穿北斗，連太微。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Jingfu, white vapor like a ring pierced the moon, passed through the Northern Dipper, and linked to the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 2 of Jingfu, white vapor like a ring pierced the moon, passed through the Northern Dipper, and linked to the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 天復二年十二月甲申，夜月有三暈，裏白，中赤黃，外綠。

translations.literal: On jiashen in the twelfth month of the second year of Tianfu, at night the moon showed a triple halo — white within, yellow-red in the middle, green without.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the twelfth month of year 2 of Tianfu, at night the moon showed a triple halo — white within, yellow-red in the middle, green without.

sentences.zh: 天祐二年二月丙申，月暈熒惑。

translations.literal: On bingshen in the second month of the second year of Tianyou, the moon's halo embraced Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the second month of year 2 of Tianyou, the moon's halo embraced Mars.

sentences.zh: 孛彗武德九年二月壬午，有星孛于胃、昴間;丁亥，孛于卷舌。

translations.literal: Bushy stars and comets — On renyin in the second month of the ninth year of Wude, a bushy star appeared between the Stomach and the Hairy Head; on dinghai it appeared at Curled Tongue.
translations.idiomatic: Bushy stars and comets — On renyin in the second month of year 9 of Wude, a bushy star appeared between the Stomach and the Hairy Head; on dinghai it appeared at Curled Tongue.

sentences.zh: 孛與彗皆非常惡氣所生，而災甚于彗。

translations.literal: Both bushy stars and comets arise from highly irregular malign qi, but the disaster of the bushy star exceeds that of the comet.
translations.idiomatic: Both bushy stars and comets arise from highly irregular malign vapor, but the disaster of the bushy star exceeds that of the comet.

sentences.zh: 貞觀八年八月甲子，有星孛于虛、危，歷玄枵，乙亥不見。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the eighth month of the eighth year of Zhenguan, a bushy star appeared at Emptiness and Rooftop, passing through Dark Eminence; on yihai it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month of year 8 of Zhenguan, a bushy star appeared at Emptiness and Rooftop, passing through Dark Eminence; on yihai it vanished.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月乙丑，有星孛于畢、昴。

translations.literal: On yichou in the third month of the thirteenth year, a bushy star appeared at the Net and the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the third month of the thirteenth year, a bushy star appeared at the Net and the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 十五年六月己酉，有星孛于太微，犯郎位，七月甲戌不見。

translations.literal: On jiyou in the sixth month of the fifteenth year, a bushy star appeared at the Supreme Palace, violating the Courtier stations; on jiaxu in the seventh month it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the sixth month of the fifteenth year, a bushy star appeared at the Supreme Palace, violating the Courtier stations; on jiaxu in the seventh month it vanished.

sentences.zh: 龍朔三年八月癸卯，有彗星于左攝提，長二尺餘，乙巳不見。

translations.literal: On guimao in the eighth month of the third year of Longshuo, a comet appeared at the left Sombre Lance, more than two chi long; on yisi it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the eighth month of year 3 of Longshuo, a comet appeared at the left Sombre Lance, more than two chi long; on yisi it vanished.

sentences.zh: 攝提，建時節，大臣象。

translations.literal: The Sombre Lance marks the season of establishment; it is the image of great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Sombre Lance marks the season of establishment; it is the image of great ministers.

sentences.zh: 乾封二年四月丙辰，有彗星于東北，在五車、畢、昴間，乙亥不見。

translations.literal: On bingchen in the fourth month of the second year of Qianfeng, a comet appeared in the northeast among the Five Chariots, the Net, and the Hairy Head; on yihai it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the fourth month of year 2 of Qianfeng, a comet appeared in the northeast among the Five Chariots, the Net, and the Hairy Head; on yihai it vanished.

sentences.zh: 上元二年十二月壬午，有彗星于角、亢南，長五尺。

translations.literal: On renwu in the twelfth month of the second year of Shangyuan, a comet appeared south of the Horn and the Neck, five chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the twelfth month of year 2 of Shangyuan, a comet appeared south of the Horn and the Neck, five chi long.

sentences.zh: 三年七月丁亥，有彗星于東井，指北河，長三尺餘；

translations.literal: On dinghai in the seventh month of the third year, a comet appeared at the Eastern Well, pointing at the North River, more than three chi long;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the seventh month of the third year, a comet appeared at the Eastern Well, pointing at the North River, more than three chi long;

sentences.zh: 東北行，光芒益盛，長三丈，掃中台，指文昌。

translations.literal: it traveled northeast; its radiance grew, reaching three zhang; it swept the Central Terrace and pointed at the Literary Glory.
translations.idiomatic: it traveled northeast; its radiance grew to three zhang; it swept the Central Terrace and pointed at Literary Glory.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，不見。

translations.literal: On yiyou in the ninth month, it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the ninth month, it vanished.

sentences.zh: 東井，京師分；

translations.literal: The Eastern Well is the allotment of the capital region;
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Well is the capital-region allotment;

sentences.zh: 中台、文昌，將相位；

translations.literal: the Central Terrace and Literary Glory are the stations of generals and ministers;
translations.idiomatic: the Central Terrace and Literary Glory are the stations of generals and ministers;

sentences.zh: 兩河，天闕也。

translations.literal: the Two Rivers are the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: the Two Rivers are the Celestial Gate.

sentences.zh: 開耀元年九月丙申，有彗星于天市中，長五丈，漸小，東行至河鼓，癸丑不見。

translations.literal: On bingshen in the ninth month of the first year of Kaiyao, a comet appeared in the Celestial Market, five zhang long; it gradually shrank and traveled east to the Drum at the River; on guichou it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the ninth month of year 1 of Kaiyao, a comet appeared in the Celestial Market, five zhang long; it gradually shrank and traveled east to the Drum at the River; on guichou it vanished.

sentences.zh: 市者，貨食之所聚，以衣食生民者；

translations.literal: The Market is where goods and food gather — where the people's clothing and food are produced;
translations.idiomatic: The Market is where goods and food gather — where the people's clothing and food are produced;

sentences.zh: 一曰帝將遷都。

translations.literal: another reading says the emperor will move the capital.
translations.idiomatic: another reading says the emperor will move the capital.

sentences.zh: 河鼓，將軍象。

translations.literal: The Drum at the River is the image of generals.
translations.idiomatic: The Drum at the River is the image of generals.

sentences.zh: 永淳二年三月丙午，有彗星于五車北，四月辛未不見。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the third month of the second year of Yongchun, a comet appeared north of the Five Chariots; on xinwei in the fourth month it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the third month of year 2 of Yongchun, a comet appeared north of the Five Chariots; on xinwei in the fourth month it vanished.

sentences.zh: 文明元年七月辛未夕，有彗星于西方，長丈餘，八月甲辰不見。

translations.literal: On xinwei evening in the seventh month of the first year of Wenming, a comet appeared in the west, more than a zhang long; on jiachen in the eighth month it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei evening in the seventh month of year 1 of Wenming, a comet appeared in the west, more than a zhang long; on jiachen in the eighth month it vanished.

sentences.zh: 是謂天攙。

translations.literal: This is called Heaven's Support.
translations.idiomatic: This is called Heaven's Support.

sentences.zh: 光宅元年九月丁丑，有星如半月，見于西方。

translations.literal: On dingchou in the ninth month of the first year of Guangzai, a star like a half-moon appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the ninth month of year 1 of Guangzai, a star like a half-moon appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 月，眾陰之長，星如月者陰盛之極。

translations.literal: The moon is the chief of all yin; a star like the moon means yin at its extreme.
translations.idiomatic: The moon is the chief of all yin; a star like the moon means yin at its extreme.

sentences.zh: 景龍元年十月壬午，有彗星于西方，十一月甲寅不見。

translations.literal: On renwu in the tenth month of the first year of Jinglong, a comet appeared in the west; on jiayin in the eleventh month it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the tenth month of year 1 of Jinglong, a comet appeared in the west; on jiayin in the eleventh month it vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年七月丁酉，有星孛于胃、昴間。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the seventh month of the second year, a bushy star appeared between the Stomach and the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the seventh month of the second year, a bushy star appeared between the Stomach and the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 胡分也。

translations.literal: This is the Hu allotment.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Hu allotment.

sentences.zh: 三年八月壬辰，有星孛于紫宮。

translations.literal: On renchen in the eighth month of the third year, a bushy star appeared at the Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the eighth month of the third year, a bushy star appeared at the Purple Palace.

sentences.zh: 延和元年六月，有彗星自軒轅入太微，至大角滅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Yanhe, a comet entered the Chariot Shaft and the Supreme Palace from the east, and was extinguished at the Great Horn.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 1 of Yanhe, a comet entered the Supreme Palace from the Chariot Shaft and was extinguished at the Great Horn.

sentences.zh: 開元十八年六月甲子，有彗星于五車。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the sixth month of the eighteenth year of Kaiyuan, a comet appeared at the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the sixth month of year 18 of Kaiyuan, a comet appeared at the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，有星孛于畢、昴。

translations.literal: On guiyou, a bushy star appeared at the Net and the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, a bushy star appeared at the Net and the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 二十六年三月丙子，有星孛于紫宮垣，歷北斗魁，旬餘，因雲陰不見。

translations.literal: On bingzi in the third month of the twenty-sixth year, a bushy star appeared in the Purple Palace ramparts, passing the handle of the Northern Dipper; after more than ten days it was hidden by cloudy shade and not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the third month of the twenty-sixth year, a bushy star appeared in the Purple Palace ramparts, passing the handle of the Northern Dipper; after more than ten days cloud and shade hid it.

sentences.zh: 乾元三年四月丁巳，有彗星于東方，在婁、胃間，色白，長四尺，東方疾行，歷昴、畢、觜觿、參、東井、輿鬼、柳、軒轅至右執法西，凡五旬餘不見。

translations.literal: On dingsi in the fourth month of the third year of Qianyuan, a comet appeared in the east among the Bond and the Stomach, white in color, four chi long; it traveled swiftly east through the Hairy Head, the Net, the Beak, the Three Stars, the Eastern Well, the Ghost Carriage, the Willow, and the Chariot Shaft to west of the Right Law-Enforcer — in all more than fifty days and then not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fourth month of year 3 of Qianyuan, a comet appeared in the east among the Bond and the Stomach, white, four chi long; it traveled swiftly east through the Hairy Head, the Net, the Beak, the Three Stars, the Eastern Well, the Ghost Carriage, the Willow, and the Chariot Shaft to west of the Right Law-Enforcer — more than fifty days in all, then gone.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛酉朔，有彗星于西方，長數丈，至五月乃滅。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the new moon of the intercalary month, a comet appeared in the west, several zhang long; it was extinguished in the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the intercalary month's new moon, a comet appeared in the west, several zhang long; it was extinguished in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 婁為魯、胃、昴、畢為趙，觜觿、參為唐，東井、輿鬼為京師分，柳其半為周分。

translations.literal: The Bond is Lu; the Stomach, the Hairy Head, and the Net are Zhao; the Beak and the Three Stars are Tang; the Eastern Well and the Ghost Carriage are the capital-region allotment; half of the Willow is the Zhou allotment.
translations.idiomatic: The Bond is Lu; the Stomach, the Hairy Head, and the Net are Zhao; the Beak and the Three Stars are Tang; the Eastern Well and the Ghost Carriage are the capital-region allotment; half of the Willow is the Zhou allotment.

sentences.zh: 二彗仍見者，荐禍也。

translations.literal: When two comets appear together, repeated calamity is meant.
translations.idiomatic: When two comets appear together, repeated calamity is meant.

sentences.zh: 又婁、胃間，天倉。

translations.literal: Moreover, between the Bond and the Stomach lies the Heavenly Granary.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, between the Bond and the Stomach lies the Heavenly Granary.

sentences.zh: 大曆元年十二月己亥，有彗星于匏瓜，長尺餘，經二旬不見，犯宦者星。

translations.literal: On jihai in the twelfth month of the first year of Dali, a comet appeared at the Gourd, more than a chi long; after twenty days it was not seen; it violated the Eunuch star.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the twelfth month of year 1 of Dali, a comet appeared at the Gourd, more than a chi long; after twenty days it vanished; it violated the Eunuch star.

sentences.zh: 五年四月己未，有彗星于五車，光芒蓬勃，長三丈。

translations.literal: On jiwei in the fourth month of the fifth year, a comet appeared at the Five Chariots, its radiance flourishing, three zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the fourth month of the fifth year, a comet appeared at the Five Chariots, its radiance flourishing, three zhang long.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，彗星見于北方，色白，癸未東行近八穀中星；

translations.literal: On jimao in the fifth month, a comet appeared in the north, white in color; on guiwei it traveled east near the central star of the Eight Granaries;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the fifth month, a comet appeared in the north, white; on guiwei it traveled east near the central star of the Eight Granaries;

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯近三公，己未不見。

translations.literal: on guimao it neared the Three Dukes; on jiwei it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: on guimao it neared the Three Dukes; on jiwei it vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「色白者，太白所生也。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When the color is white, it is born of the Great White."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When the color is white, it is born of the Great White."

sentences.zh: 」七年十二月丙寅，有長星于參下，其長亙天。

translations.literal: " In the seventh year, on bingyin in the twelfth month, there was a long star below Shen; its length spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on bingyin in the twelfth month, a long comet appeared below the Shen lodge, its tail spanning the sky.

sentences.zh: 長星，彗屬。

translations.literal: Long stars belong to the comet category.
translations.idiomatic: Long stars are a type of comet.

sentences.zh: 參，唐星也。

translations.literal: Shen is the star of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen is the Tang allotment star.

sentences.zh: 元和十年三月，有長星于太微，尾至軒轅。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year of Yuanhe, a long star appeared at the Supreme Palace; its tail reached the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuanhe 10, a long comet appeared at the Supreme Palace, its tail reaching the Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月戊子，有彗星于畢。

translations.literal: On wuzi in the first month of the twelfth year, a comet appeared at Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the first month of year 12, a comet appeared at the Bi lodge.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年正月己未，有星孛于翼；

translations.literal: On jiwei in the first month of the first year of Changqing, a bushy star appeared at Yi;
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the first month of Changqing 1, a bushy star appeared at the Yi lodge;

sentences.zh: 丁卯，孛于太微西上將。

translations.literal: on dingmao it bushed at the Western Upper General of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: on dingmao it bushed at the Western Upper General of the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月，有彗星于昴，長一丈，凡十日不見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, a comet appeared at Mao, one zhang long; after ten days it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a comet appeared at the Mao lodge, one zhang long; after ten days it vanished.

sentences.zh: 大和二年七月甲辰，有彗星于右攝提南，長二尺。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the seventh month of the second year of Dahe, a comet appeared south of the Right Screenshoting Support, two chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the seventh month of Dahe 2, a comet appeared south of the Right Screenshoting Support, two chi long.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，客星見于水位。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, a guest star appeared at the Water Level.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 3, a guest star appeared at the Water Level.

sentences.zh: 八年九月辛亥，有彗星于太微，長丈餘，西北行，越郎位，庚申不見。

translations.literal: On xinhai in the ninth month of the eighth year, a comet appeared at the Supreme Palace, more than a zhang long; it traveled northwest, crossing the Courtier's Station, and on gengshen was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the ninth month of year 8, a comet appeared at the Supreme Palace, more than a zhang long; it traveled northwest, crossing the Courtier's Station, and vanished on gengshen.

sentences.zh: 開成二年二月丙午，有彗星于危，長七尺餘，西指南斗；

translations.literal: On bingwu in the second month of the second year of Kaicheng, a comet appeared at Wei, more than seven chi long, pointing west toward the Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the second month of Kaicheng 2, a comet appeared at the Wei lodge, more than seven chi long, pointing west toward the Dipper;

sentences.zh: 戊申在危西南，芒耀愈盛；

translations.literal: on wushen it was southwest of Wei, its radiance growing ever brighter;
translations.idiomatic: on wushen it stood southwest of Wei, its radiance growing ever brighter;

sentences.zh: 癸丑在虛；

translations.literal: on guichou it was at Xu;
translations.idiomatic: on guichou it was at the Xu lodge;

sentences.zh: 辛酉，長丈餘，西行稍南指；

translations.literal: on xinyou it was more than a zhang long, traveling west and pointing slightly south;
translations.idiomatic: on xinyou it was more than a zhang long, traveling west and pointing slightly south;

sentences.zh: 壬戌，在婺女，長二丈餘，廣三尺；

translations.literal: on renxu it was at Nu, more than two zhang long and three chi wide;
translations.idiomatic: on renxu it was at the Nu lodge, more than two zhang long and three chi wide;

sentences.zh: 癸亥，愈長且闊；

translations.literal: on guihai it grew longer and broader;
translations.idiomatic: on guihai it grew longer and broader;

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，在南斗；

translations.literal: On jiazi in the third month, it was at the Southern Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the third month, it was at the Southern Dipper;

sentences.zh: 乙丑，長五丈，其末兩岐，一指氐，一掩房；

translations.literal: on yichou it was five zhang long; its tip forked in two — one prong toward Di, one covering Fang;
translations.idiomatic: on yichou it was five zhang long; its tip forked in two — one prong toward Di, one covering Fang;

sentences.zh: 丙寅，長六丈，無岐，北指在亢七度；

translations.literal: on bingyin it was six zhang long, without fork, pointing north at seven degrees within Kang;
translations.idiomatic: on bingyin it was six zhang long, without fork, pointing north at seven degrees within the Kang lodge;

sentences.zh: 丁卯，西北行，東指；

translations.literal: on dingmao it traveled northwest, pointing east;
translations.idiomatic: on dingmao it traveled northwest, pointing east;

sentences.zh: 己巳，長八丈餘，在張；

translations.literal: on jisi it was more than eight zhang long, at Zhang;
translations.idiomatic: on jisi it was more than eight zhang long, at the Zhang lodge;

sentences.zh: 癸未，長三尺，在軒轅右不見。

translations.literal: on guiwei it was three chi long, at the right of the Chariot Shaft and not seen.
translations.idiomatic: on guiwei it was three chi long, at the right of the Chariot Shaft and then gone.

sentences.zh: 凡彗星晨出則西指，夕出則東指，乃常也，未有遍指四方，凌犯如此之甚者。

translations.literal: As a rule, when a comet appears at dawn it points west, and when it appears at dusk it points east — that is normal; never before had one pointed in all four directions and violated the lodges so severely.
translations.idiomatic: As a rule, comets appearing at dawn point west and those at dusk point east — that is normal; never before had one swept all four directions and violated the lodges so severely.

sentences.zh: 甲申，客星出于東井下。

translations.literal: On jiashen, a guest star emerged below the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, a guest star emerged below the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 戊子，客星別出于端門內，近屏星。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a separate guest star emerged inside the End Gate, near the Screen Star.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, a separate guest star emerged inside the End Gate, near the Screen Star.

sentences.zh: 四月丙午，東井下客星沒。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the fourth month, the guest star below the Eastern Well was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fourth month, the guest star below the Eastern Well vanished.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，端門內客星沒。

translations.literal: On guiyou in the fifth month, the guest star inside the End Gate was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the fifth month, the guest star inside the End Gate vanished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，客星如孛，在南斗天籥旁。

translations.literal: On renwu, a guest star like a bushy star appeared beside the Celestial Lock of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a guest star like a bushy star appeared beside the Celestial Lock of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，有彗星于虛、危，虛、危為玄枵。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the eighth month, a comet appeared at Xu and Wei; Xu and Wei are the Dark Boar.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the eighth month, a comet appeared at the Xu and Wei lodges; Xu and Wei are the Dark Boar.

sentences.zh: 枵，耗名也。

translations.literal: Xiao — a name for depletion.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao — a name signifying depletion.

sentences.zh: 三年十月乙巳，有彗星于軫魁，長二丈餘，漸長，西指。

translations.literal: On yisi in the tenth month of the third year, a comet appeared at the head of Zhen, more than two zhang long; it gradually lengthened, pointing west.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the tenth month of year 3, a comet appeared at the head of the Zhen lodge, more than two zhang long; it gradually lengthened, pointing west.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，有彗星于東方，在尾、箕，東西亙天；

translations.literal: On yimao in the eleventh month, a comet appeared in the east at Wei and Ji, spanning heaven east to west;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the eleventh month, a comet appeared in the east at the Wei and Ji lodges, spanning heaven east to west;

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰不見。

translations.literal: on renchen in the twelfth month it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: on renchen in the twelfth month it vanished.

sentences.zh: 四年正月癸酉，有彗星于羽林。

translations.literal: On guiyou in the first month of the fourth year, a comet appeared at the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the first month of year 4, a comet appeared at the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 衞分也。

translations.literal: This is the Wei allotment.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Wei allotment.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午，有彗星于卷舌西北；

translations.literal: On bingwu in the intercalary month, a comet appeared northwest of the Rolled Tongue;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the intercalary month, a comet appeared northwest of the Rolled Tongue;

sentences.zh: 二月己卯不見。

translations.literal: on jimao in the second month it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: on jimao in the second month it vanished.

sentences.zh: 五年二月庚申，有彗星于營室、東壁間，二十日滅。

translations.literal: On gengshen in the second month of the fifth year, a comet appeared between the Encampment and the Eastern Wall; after twenty days it was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the second month of year 5, a comet appeared between the Encampment and the Eastern Wall; after twenty days it was extinguished.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，有彗星于東方。

translations.literal: On wuyin in the eleventh month, a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the eleventh month, a comet appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 燕分也。

translations.literal: This is the Yan allotment.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Yan allotment.

sentences.zh: 會昌元年七月，有彗星于羽林、營室、東壁間也。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Huichang, a comet appeared among the Feathered Forest, the Encampment, and the Eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Huichang 1, a comet appeared among the Feathered Forest, the Encampment, and the Eastern Wall.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，有彗星于北落師門，在營室，入紫宮，十二月辛卯不見。

translations.literal: On renyin in the eleventh month, a comet appeared at the Northern Falling Teacher Gate, at the Encampment; it entered the Purple Palace, and on xinmao in the twelfth month was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the eleventh month, a comet appeared at the Northern Falling Teacher Gate, at the Encampment; it entered the Purple Palace, and vanished on xinmao in the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 幷州分也。

translations.literal: This is the Bingzhou allotment.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Bingzhou allotment.

sentences.zh: 大中六年三月，有彗星于觜、參。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of Dazhong, a comet appeared at Zui and Shen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Dazhong 6, a comet appeared at the Zui and Shen lodges.

sentences.zh: 參，唐星也。

translations.literal: Shen is the star of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Shen is the Tang allotment star.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月乙未，有彗星于房，長三尺。

translations.literal: On yiwei in the ninth month of the eleventh year, a comet appeared at Fang, three chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the ninth month of year 11, a comet appeared at the Fang lodge, three chi long.

sentences.zh: 咸通五年五月己亥，夜漏未盡一刻，有彗星出于東北，色黃白，長三尺，在婁。

translations.literal: On jihai in the fifth month of the fifth year of Xiantong, before the night watch had ended by one quarter, a comet emerged in the northeast, yellow-white in color, three chi long, at Lou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fifth month of Xiantong 5, before the night watch had ended by one quarter, a comet emerged in the northeast, yellow-white, three chi long, at the Lou lodge.

sentences.zh: 徐州分也。

translations.literal: This is the Xuzhou allotment.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Xuzhou allotment.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，有彗星于婁、胃。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, a comet appeared at Lou and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 9, a comet appeared at the Lou and Wei lodges.

sentences.zh: 十年八月，有彗星于大陵，東北指。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the tenth year, a comet appeared at the Great Tumulus, pointing northeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 10, a comet appeared at the Great Tumulus, pointing northeast.

sentences.zh: 占為外夷兵及水災。

translations.literal: The prognostication is for foreign barbarian armies and flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The omen prognosticated foreign armies and flood disaster.

sentences.zh: 乾符四年五月，有彗星。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Qianfu, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Qianfu 4, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 光啟元年，有彗星于積水、積薪之間。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangqi, a comet appeared between Stored Water and Stored Firewood.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangqi 1, a comet appeared between Stored Water and Stored Firewood.

sentences.zh: 二年五月丙戌，有星孛于尾、箕，歷北斗、攝提。

translations.literal: On bingxu in the fifth month of the second year, a bushy star appeared at Wei and Ji, passing the Northern Dipper and the Screenshoting Support.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the fifth month of year 2, a bushy star appeared at the Wei and Ji lodges, passing the Northern Dipper and the Screenshoting Support.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「貴臣誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Noble ministers will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Noble ministers will be executed.

sentences.zh: 大順二年四月庚辰，有彗星于三台，東行入太微，掃大角、天市，長十丈餘，五月甲戌不見。

translations.literal: On gengchen in the fourth month of the second year of Dashun, a comet appeared at the Three Steps; it traveled east into the Supreme Palace, sweeping the Great Horn and the Celestial Market, more than ten zhang long; on jiaxu in the fifth month it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the fourth month of Dashun 2, a comet appeared at the Three Steps; it traveled east into the Supreme Palace, sweeping the Great Horn and the Celestial Market, more than ten zhang long; it vanished on jiaxu in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 宦者陳匡知星，奏曰：「當有亂臣入宮。

translations.literal: The eunuch Chen Kuang, who knew the stars, memorialized: "A rebellious minister will enter the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Chen Kuang, versed in the stars, memorialized: "A rebellious minister will enter the palace.

sentences.zh: 」三台，太一三階也；

translations.literal: " The Three Steps are the three tiers of the Great One;
translations.idiomatic: " The Three Steps are the three tiers of the Great One;

sentences.zh: 太微大角，帝廷也；

translations.literal: the Supreme Palace and the Great Horn are the imperial court;
translations.idiomatic: the Supreme Palace and the Great Horn are the imperial court;

sentences.zh: 天市，都市也。

translations.literal: the Celestial Market is the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: the Celestial Market is the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 景福元年五月，蚩尤旗見，初出有白彗，形如髮，長二尺許，經數日，乃從中天下，如匹布，至地如蛇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Jingfu, the Chiyou Banner appeared; when it first emerged there was a white comet shaped like hair, about two chi long; after several days it descended from mid-heaven like a bolt of cloth, reaching the ground like a serpent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Jingfu 1, the Chiyou Banner appeared; when it first emerged a white comet shaped like hair, about two chi long, appeared; after several days it descended from mid-heaven like a bolt of cloth, reaching the ground like a serpent.

sentences.zh: 六月，孫儒攻楊行密于宣州，有黑雲如山，漸下，墜于儒營上，狀如破屋。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Sun Ru attacked Yang Xingmi at Xuanzhou; a black cloud like a mountain gradually descended and fell upon Ru's camp, shaped like a ruined house.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Sun Ru attacked Yang Xingmi at Xuanzhou; a black cloud like a mountain gradually descended and fell upon Ru's camp, shaped like a ruined house.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「營頭星也。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "This is the Camp-Head star.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This is the Camp-Head star.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，有星孛于斗、牛。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month, a bushy star appeared at the Dipper and the Ox.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh month, a bushy star appeared at the Dipper and Ox lodges.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「越有自立者。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Yue will have one who establishes himself.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Yue will have one who establishes himself.

sentences.zh: 」十二月丙子，天攙出于西南；

translations.literal: " On bingzi in the twelfth month, the Celestial Intruder emerged in the southwest;
translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi in the twelfth month, the Celestial Intruder emerged in the southwest;

sentences.zh: 己卯，化為雲而沒。

translations.literal: on jimao it transformed into a cloud and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: on jimao it transformed into a cloud and vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，天久陰，至四月乙酉夜，雲稍開，有彗星于上台，長十餘丈，東行入太微，掃大角，入天市，經三旬有七日，益長，至二十餘丈，因雲陰不見。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, the sky was long overcast; on the night of yiyou in the fourth month the clouds parted slightly, and a comet appeared at the Upper Step, more than ten zhang long; it traveled east into the Supreme Palace, sweeping the Great Horn, and entered the Celestial Market; after thirty-seven days it grew longer, reaching more than twenty zhang, then was hidden by cloudy shade and not seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 2, the sky was long overcast; on the night of yiyou in the fourth month the clouds parted slightly, and a comet appeared at the Upper Step, more than ten zhang long; it traveled east into the Supreme Palace, sweeping the Great Horn, and entered the Celestial Market; after thirty-seven days it grew longer, reaching more than twenty zhang, then cloud and shade hid it.

sentences.zh: 乾寧元年正月，有星孛于鶉首。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Qianning, a bushy star appeared at the Quail's Head.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Qianning 1, a bushy star appeared at the Quail's Head.

sentences.zh: 秦分也。

translations.literal: This is the Qin allotment.
translations.idiomatic: This is the Qin allotment.

sentences.zh: 又星隕于西南，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Moreover, a falling star fell in the southwest, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, a falling star fell in the southwest with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 七月，妖星見，非彗非孛，不知其名，時人謂之妖星，或曰惡星。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, an aberrant star appeared — neither comet nor bushy star; its name was unknown; people of the time called it the aberrant star, or the evil star.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, an aberrant star appeared — neither comet nor bushy star; its name was unknown; people of the time called it the aberrant star, or the evil star.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，有客星三，一大二小，在虛、危間，乍合乍離，相隨東行，狀如鬬，經三日而二小星沒，其大星後沒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year, three guest stars appeared — one large and two small — between Xu and Wei; now joining, now separating, they followed one another eastward, shaped like fighting; after three days the two small stars were extinguished, and afterward the large star was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 3, three guest stars appeared — one large and two small — between the Xu and Wei lodges; now joining, now separating, they followed one another eastward, shaped like fighting; after three days the two small stars vanished, and afterward the large star vanished.

sentences.zh: 虛、危，齊分也。

translations.literal: Xu and Wei are the Qi allotment.
translations.idiomatic: The Xu and Wei lodges are the Qi allotment.

sentences.zh: 光化三年正月，客星出于中垣宦者旁，大如桃，光炎射宦者，宦者不見。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Guanghua, a guest star emerged beside the Eunuch within the Inner Enclosure, large as a peach; its blazing light shone upon the Eunuch, and the Eunuch was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Guanghua 3, a guest star emerged beside the Eunuch within the Inner Enclosure, large as a peach; its blazing light shone upon the Eunuch, and the Eunuch was not seen.

sentences.zh: 天復元年五月，有三赤星，各有鋒芒，在南方，既而西方、北方、東方亦如之，頃之，又各增一星，凡十六星；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Tianfu, three red stars appeared, each with sharp points, in the south; shortly afterward the west, north, and east likewise had them; in a moment each region gained one more star — sixteen stars in all;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Tianfu 1, three red stars appeared, each with sharp points, in the south; shortly afterward the west, north, and east likewise had them; in a moment each region gained one more star — sixteen stars in all;

sentences.zh: 少時，先從北滅。

translations.literal: after a short while, they were extinguished first from the north.
translations.idiomatic: after a short while, they vanished first from the north.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「濛星也，見則諸侯兵相攻。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "These are hazy stars; when they appear, feudal lords' armies attack one another.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "These are hazy stars; when they appear, feudal lords' armies attack one another.

sentences.zh: 」二年正月，客星如桃，在紫宮華蓋下，漸行至御女。

translations.literal: " In the first month of the second year, a guest star like a peach appeared below the Canopy of the Purple Palace; it gradually traveled to the Serving Maid.
translations.idiomatic: " In the first month of year 2, a guest star like a peach appeared below the Canopy of the Purple Palace; it gradually traveled to the Serving Maid.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，有流星起文昌，抵客星，客星不動；

translations.literal: On dingmao, a streaming star rose from Literary Glory and reached the guest star; the guest star did not move;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, a streaming star rose from Literary Glory and reached the guest star; the guest star did not move;

sentences.zh: 己巳，客星在杠，守之，至明年猶不去。

translations.literal: on jisi the guest star was at the Pole, guarding it; even into the next year it still did not depart.
translations.idiomatic: on jisi the guest star was at the Pole, guarding it; even into the next year it still did not depart.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「將相出兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Generals and ministers will lead armies forth.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Generals and ministers will lead armies forth.

sentences.zh: 」五月夕，有星當箕下，如炬火，炎炎上衝，人初以為燒火也，高丈餘乃隕。

translations.literal: " In the evening of the fifth month, a star below Ji was like a torch flame, blazing upward; at first people thought it was a fire burning; only after it rose more than a zhang did it fall.
translations.idiomatic: " In the evening of the fifth month, a star below the Ji lodge was like a torch flame, blazing upward; at first people thought it was a fire burning; only after it rose more than a zhang did it fall.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「機星也，下有亂。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "This is the Engine star; below it there will be disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This is the Engine star; below it there will be disorder.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年四月，有星狀如人，首赤身黑，在北斗下紫微中。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Tianyou, a star shaped like a person, red of head and black of body, appeared within the Purple Enclosure below the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Tianyou 1, a star shaped like a person, red of head and black of body, appeared within the Purple Enclosure below the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天衝也。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "This is the Celestial Rush.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This is the Celestial Rush.

sentences.zh: 天衝抱極泣帝前，血濁霧下天下冤。

translations.literal: The Celestial Rush embraces the pole and weeps before the emperor; blood and foul mist descend — the realm's wrongs rain down.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Rush embraces the pole and weeps before the emperor; blood and foul mist descend — the realm's wrongs rain down.

sentences.zh: 」後三日而黑風晦暝。

translations.literal: " Three days afterward came black wind and dark obscurity.
translations.idiomatic: " Three days afterward came black wind and dark obscurity.

sentences.zh: 二年四月庚子夕，西北隅有星類太白，上有光似彗，長三四丈，色如赭；

translations.literal: On the evening of gengzi in the fourth month of the second year, in the northwest corner there was a star resembling the Great White, with light above it like a comet, three or four zhang long, ochre in color;
translations.idiomatic: On the evening of gengzi in the fourth month of year 2, in the northwest corner there was a star resembling the Great White, with light above it like a comet, three or four zhang long, ochre in color;

sentences.zh: 辛丑夕，色如縞。

translations.literal: on the evening of xinchou the color was like white silk.
translations.idiomatic: on the evening of xinchou the color was like white silk.

sentences.zh: 或曰五車之水星也，一曰昭明星也。

translations.literal: Some say it was the water star of the Five Chariots; others say it was the Bright Morning Star.
translations.idiomatic: Some say it was the water star of the Five Chariots; others say it was the Bright Morning Star.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，有彗星于北河，貫文昌，長三丈餘，陵中台、下台；

translations.literal: On jiachen, a comet appeared at the North River, piercing Literary Glory, more than three zhang long, violating the Middle Step and the Lower Step;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, a comet appeared at the North River, piercing Literary Glory, more than three zhang long, violating the Middle Step and the Lower Step;

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑夜，自軒轅左角及天市西垣，光芒猛怒，其長亙天；

translations.literal: On the night of yichou in the fifth month, from the left horn of the Chariot Shaft to the western rampart of the Celestial Market, its radiance was fierce and angry, its length spanning heaven;
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yichou in the fifth month, from the left horn of the Chariot Shaft to the western rampart of the Celestial Market, its radiance was fierce and angry, its length spanning heaven;

sentences.zh: 丙寅雲陰，至辛未少霽，不見。

translations.literal: on bingyin clouds were overcast; until xinwei there was slight clearing, and it was not seen.
translations.idiomatic: on bingyin clouds were overcast; until xinwei there was slight clearing, and it was not seen.

sentences.zh: 兩河為天闕，在東井間，而北河，中國所經也。

translations.literal: The Two Rivers are the Heavenly Gate, between the Eastern Well; the North River is what China passes through.
translations.idiomatic: The Two Rivers are the Heavenly Gate, between the Eastern Well; the North River is what China passes through.

sentences.zh: 文昌，天之六司。

translations.literal: Literary Glory — heaven's six ministries.
translations.idiomatic: Literary Glory — heaven's six ministries.

sentences.zh: 天市，都市也。

translations.literal: The Celestial Market is the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Market is the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 星變武德三年十月己未，有星隕于東都中，隱隱有聲。

translations.literal: [Star anomalies.] In the third year of Wude, on the sixteenth day of the tenth month, day jiwei, a star fell within the Eastern Capital, with a faint sound.
translations.idiomatic: Star anomalies — In year 3 of Wude, on jiwei, the sixteenth day of the tenth month, a star fell within the Eastern Capital, and a faint sound was heard.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二年，天狗隕于夏州城中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenguan, a celestial dog fell within the city of Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenguan, a celestial dog fell within the city of Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十四年八月，有星隕于高昌城中。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourteenth year, a star fell within the city of Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 14, a star fell within the city of Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 十六年六月甲辰，西方有流星如月，西南行三丈乃滅。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the sixth month of the sixteenth year, in the west there was a streaming star like the moon; it traveled southwest for three zhang and then was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the sixth month of year 16, a streaming star like the moon appeared in the west; it traveled southwest for three zhang and then vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「星甚大者，為人主。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When a star is very large, it signifies the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When a star is very large, it signifies the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 」十八年五月，流星出東壁，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month of the eighteenth year, a streaming star came forth from the Eastern Wall, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month of year 18, a streaming star came forth from the Eastern Wall with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「聲如雷者，怒象。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When the sound is like thunder, it is an omen of wrath.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When the sound is like thunder, it is an omen of wrath.

sentences.zh: 」十九年四月己酉，有流星向北斗杓而滅。

translations.literal: " On jiyou of the fourth month of the nineteenth year, there was a streaming star that moved toward the ladle of the Northern Dipper and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiyou of the fourth month of year 19, a streaming star moved toward the ladle of the Northern Dipper and vanished.

sentences.zh: 永徽三年十月，有流星貫北極。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of Yonghui, there was a streaming star that pierced through the North Pole.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Yonghui 3, a streaming star pierced through the North Pole.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，睦州女子陳碩真反，婺州刺史崔義玄討之，有星隕于賊營。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Chen Shuozhen, a woman of Mu Prefecture, rebelled; Cui Yixuan, prefect of Wu Prefecture, attacked her, and a star fell in the rebels' camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 4, Chen Shuozhen of Mu Prefecture rose in rebellion; Cui Yixuan, prefect of Wu, marched against her, and a star fell in the rebel camp.

sentences.zh: 乾封元年正月癸酉，有星出太微，東流，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the first month of the first year of Qianfeng, a star came forth from the Supreme Palace, flowed eastward, and had a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the first month of Qianfeng 1, a star came forth from the Supreme Palace, flowed eastward, and sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 咸亨元年十一月，西方有流星聲如雷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Xianheng, in the west there was a streaming star with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Xianheng 1, a streaming star in the west sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 調露元年十一月戊寅，流星入北斗魁中；

translations.literal: On wuyin of the eleventh month of the first year of Diaolu, a streaming star entered the head of the Northern Dipper;
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the eleventh month of Diaolu 1, a streaming star entered the head of the Northern Dipper;

sentences.zh: 乙巳，流星燭地有光，使星也。

translations.literal: on yisi, a streaming star lit the ground with its light — an envoy star.
translations.idiomatic: on yisi, a streaming star lit the ground with its light — an envoy star.

sentences.zh: 神龍三年二月丙辰，有流星聲如頹牆，光燭天地。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the second month of the third year of Shenlong, there was a streaming star with a sound like a collapsing wall; its light lit heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the second month of Shenlong 3, a streaming star sounded like a collapsing wall, and its light lit heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年二月癸未，有大星隕于西南，聲如雷，野雉皆雊。

translations.literal: On guiwei of the second month of the second year of Jinglong, a large star fell in the southwest with a sound like thunder, and all the wild pheasants called out.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei of the second month of Jinglong 2, a large star fell in the southwest with a sound like thunder, and wild pheasants cried out everywhere.

sentences.zh: 景雲元年八月己未，有流星出五車，至上台滅。

translations.literal: On jiwei of the eighth month of the first year of Jingyun, there was a streaming star that came forth from the Five Chariots and was extinguished at the Upper Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei of the eighth month of Jingyun 1, a streaming star came forth from the Five Chariots and vanished at the Upper Terrace.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，有流星出中台，至相滅。

translations.literal: On jiashen of the ninth month, there was a streaming star that came forth from the Middle Terrace and was extinguished at Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen of the ninth month, a streaming star came forth from the Middle Terrace and vanished at Xiang.

sentences.zh: 太極元年正月辛卯，有流星出太微，至相滅。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the first month of the first year of Taiji, there was a streaming star that came forth from the Supreme Palace and was extinguished at Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao of the first month of Taiji 1, a streaming star came forth from the Supreme Palace and vanished at Xiang.

sentences.zh: 延和元年六月，幽州都督孫佺討奚、契丹，出師之夕，有大星隕于營中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Yanhe, Sun Quan, military governor of You Prefecture, attacked the Xi and Khitan; on the night the army marched forth, a large star fell in the camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Yanhe 1, Sun Quan, military governor of You, marched against the Xi and Khitan; on the night the army set out, a large star fell in the camp.

sentences.zh: 開元二年五月乙卯晦，有星西北流，或如甕，或如斗，貫北極，小者不可勝數，天星盡搖，至曙乃止。

translations.literal: On the last day of the fifth month, day yimao, of the second year of Kaiyuan, stars streamed northwest — some like jars, some like dippers — piercing the North Pole; the small ones were beyond counting; all the stars of heaven trembled, and only at dawn did it cease.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the fifth month, yimao, of Kaiyuan 2, stars streamed northwest — some like jars, some like dippers — piercing the North Pole; the smaller ones were beyond counting; every star in the sky trembled, and only at dawn did it stop.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「星，民象；

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Stars are the omen of the people;
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Stars are the omen of the people;

sentences.zh: 流者，失其所也。

translations.literal: streaming ones are those who have lost their place.
translations.idiomatic: streaming ones are those who have lost their place.

sentences.zh: 」漢書曰：「星搖者民勞。

translations.literal: " The Book of Han says: "When stars tremble, the people are exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: " The Book of Han says: "When stars tremble, the people are exhausted.

sentences.zh: 」十二年十月壬辰，流星大如桃，色赤黃，有光燭地。

translations.literal: " On renchen of the tenth month of the twelfth year, a streaming star as large as a peach, colored red-yellow, with light that lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen of the tenth month of year 12, a streaming star as large as a peach, colored red-yellow, with light that lit the ground.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「色赤為將軍使。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Red color signifies a general's envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Red color signifies a general's envoy.

sentences.zh: 天寶三載閏二月辛亥，有星如月，墜于東南，墜後有聲。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the intercalary second month of the third year of Tianbao, there was a star like the moon that fell in the southeast; after it fell there was a sound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the intercalary second month of Tianbao 3, a star like the moon fell in the southeast, and a sound followed its fall.

sentences.zh: 至德二載，賊將武令珣圍南陽，四月甲辰夜中，有大星赤黃色，長數十丈，光燭地，墜賊營中。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhide, the rebel general Wu Lingxun besieged Nanyang; in the middle of the night on jiachen of the fourth month, a large star, red-yellow in color and several tens of zhang long, with light that lit the ground, fell in the rebels' camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhide 2, the rebel general Wu Lingxun besieged Nanyang; in the middle of the night on jiachen of the fourth month, a large star, red-yellow and several tens of zhang long, lit the ground as it fell into the rebel camp.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，有流星大如斗，東北流，長數丈，蛇行屈曲，有碎光迸出。

translations.literal: On renxu of the eleventh month, there was a streaming star as large as a dipper that flowed northeast, several zhang long, winding and bending like a serpent, with shattered light bursting forth.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the eleventh month, a streaming star as large as a dipper flowed northeast for several zhang, winding like a serpent, with shattered light bursting forth.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「是謂枉矢。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "This is called the Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This is called the Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 廣德二年六月丁卯，有妖星隕于汾州。

translations.literal: On dingmao of the sixth month of the second year of Guangde, an aberrant star fell in Fen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao of the sixth month of Guangde 2, an aberrant star fell in Fen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，自乙夜至曙，星流如雨。

translations.literal: On bingyin of the twelfth month, from the second watch until dawn, stars streamed like rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin of the twelfth month, from the second watch until dawn, stars streamed like rain.

sentences.zh: 大曆二年九月乙丑，晝有星如一斗器，色黃，有尾長六丈餘，出南方，沒于東北。

translations.literal: On yichou of the ninth month of the second year of Dali, in daylight there was a star like a dipper measure, yellow in color, with a tail more than six zhang long; it came forth in the south and was extinguished in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the ninth month of Dali 2, in daylight a star like a dipper measure appeared, yellow in color, with a tail more than six zhang long; it rose in the south and vanished in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 東北于中國，則幽州分也。

translations.literal: The northeast within China is the allotment of You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Within China, the northeast is the You Prefecture allotment.

sentences.zh: 三年九月乙亥，有星大如斗，北流，有光燭地，占為貴使。

translations.literal: On yihai of the ninth month of the third year, there was a star as large as a dipper that flowed northward, with light that lit the ground; the prognostication was for a noble envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai of the ninth month of year 3, a star as large as a dipper flowed northward, lighting the ground; the omen was read as a noble envoy.

sentences.zh: 六年九月甲辰，有星西流，大如一升器，光燭地，有尾，迸光如珠，長五丈，出婺女，入天市南垣滅。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the ninth month of the sixth year, there was a star that streamed westward, as large as a one-sheng vessel, with light that lit the ground; it had a tail, with bursting light like pearls, five zhang long; it came forth from the Serving Maid and was extinguished at the southern rampart of the Celestial Market.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the ninth month of year 6, a star streamed westward, as large as a one-sheng vessel, lighting the ground; its tail burst with light like pearls for five zhang; it rose from the Serving Maid and vanished at the southern rampart of the Celestial Market.

sentences.zh: 八年六月戊辰，有流星大如一升器，有尾，長三丈餘，入太微。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the sixth month of the eighth year, there was a streaming star as large as a one-sheng vessel, with a tail more than three zhang long, that entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the sixth month of year 8, a streaming star as large as a one-sheng vessel, with a tail more than three zhang long, entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，有流星大如一升器，有尾，長二丈餘，出紫微入濁。

translations.literal: On renshen of the twelfth month, there was a streaming star as large as a one-sheng vessel, with a tail more than two zhang long, that came forth from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and entered the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the twelfth month, a streaming star as large as a one-sheng vessel, with a tail more than two zhang long, came forth from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and entered the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 十年三月戊戌，有流星出于西方，如二升器，有尾，長二丈，入濁。

translations.literal: On wuxu of the third month of the tenth year, there was a streaming star that came forth in the west, like a two-sheng vessel, with a tail two zhang long, that entered the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu of the third month of year 10, a streaming star came forth in the west, like a two-sheng vessel, with a tail two zhang long, and entered the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月辛亥，有流星如桃，尾長十丈，出匏瓜，入太微。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the second month of the twelfth year, there was a streaming star like a peach, with a tail ten zhang long, that came forth from the Gourd and entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the second month of year 12, a streaming star like a peach, with a tail ten zhang long, came forth from the Gourd and entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 建中四年八月庚申，有星隕于京師。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the eighth month of the fourth year of Jianzhong, a star fell in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the eighth month of Jianzhong 4, a star fell in the capital.

sentences.zh: 興元元年六月戊午，星或什或伍而隕。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the sixth month of the first year of Xingyuan, stars fell in groups of ten or five.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu of the sixth month of Xingyuan 1, stars fell in groups of ten or five.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年閏五月戊寅，枉矢墜于虛、危。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the intercalary fifth month of the third year of Zhenyuan, the Crooked Arrow fell between Xu and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the intercalary fifth month of Zhenyuan 3, the Crooked Arrow fell between the Xu and Wei lodges.

sentences.zh: 十四年閏五月辛亥，有星墜于東北，光燭如晝，聲如雷。

translations.literal: On xinhai of the intercalary fifth month of the fourteenth year, a star fell in the northeast; its light lit the ground like day, and its sound was like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the intercalary fifth month of year 14, a star fell in the northeast, lighting the ground like day and sounding like thunder.

sentences.zh: 元和二年十二月己巳，西北有流星亙天，尾散如珠。

translations.literal: On jisi of the twelfth month of the second year of Yuanhe, in the northwest there was a streaming star spanning heaven; its tail scattered like pearls.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the twelfth month of Yuanhe 2, a streaming star in the northwest spanned the sky, its tail scattering like pearls.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有貴使。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a noble envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be a noble envoy.

sentences.zh: 」四年八月丁丑，西北有大星，東南流，聲如雷鼓。

translations.literal: " On dingchou of the eighth month of the fourth year, in the northwest there was a large star that streamed southeast, with a sound like thunder and drums.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingchou of the eighth month of year 4, a large star in the northwest streamed southeast with a sound like thunder and drums.

sentences.zh: 六年三月戊戌日晡，天陰寒，有流星大如一斛器，墜于兗、鄆間，聲震數百里，野雉皆雊，所墜之上，有赤氣如立蛇，長丈餘，至夕乃滅。

translations.literal: In the afternoon on wuxu of the third month of the sixth year, the sky was overcast and cold; there was a streaming star as large as a one-hu vessel that fell between Yan and Yun; its sound shook the ground for several hundred li, and all the wild pheasants called out; above where it fell there was red vapor like an upright serpent, more than a zhang long, which only at evening was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In the afternoon on wuxu of the third month of year 6, under an overcast, cold sky, a streaming star as large as a one-hu vessel fell between Yan and Yun; its sound shook the ground for hundreds of li, and wild pheasants cried out everywhere; above the place where it fell rose red vapor like an upright serpent, more than a zhang long, which did not fade until evening.

sentences.zh: 時占者以為日在戌，魯分也，不及十年，其野主殺而地分。

translations.literal: At the time the prognosticators held that the sun was in Xu — the Lu allotment — and that within less than ten years its territory's lord would be killed and the land divided.
translations.idiomatic: At the time prognosticators held that the sun was in Xu — the Lu allotment — and that within less than ten years its lord would be killed and the land divided.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，有大星如半席，自下而升，有光燭地，羣小星隨之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, there was a large star like half a mat that rose from below upward, with light that lit the ground, and a host of small stars followed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 9, a large star like half a mat rose from below, lighting the ground, and a host of small stars followed it.

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，有大流星，尾迹長五丈餘，光燭地，至右攝提西滅。

translations.literal: On xinsi of the fourth month, there was a large streaming star with a tail-trail more than five zhang long, with light that lit the ground; it was extinguished west of the Right Sombre Lance.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the fourth month, a large streaming star left a tail-trail more than five zhang long, lighting the ground; it vanished west of the Right Sombre Lance.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月己亥甲夜，有流星起中天，首如甕，尾如二百斛舡，長十餘丈，聲如羣鴨飛，明若火炬，過月下西流，須臾，有聲礱礱，墜地，有大聲如壞屋者三，在陳、蔡間。

translations.literal: On the first night of jihai of the ninth month of the twelfth year, a streaming star rose at mid-heaven; its head was like a jar and its tail like a two-hundred-hu boat, more than ten zhang long; its sound was like a flock of ducks in flight, bright as a torch; it passed below the moon and streamed westward; in a moment there was a grinding sound as it struck the ground, and three great sounds like collapsing houses between Chen and Cai.
translations.idiomatic: On the first night of jihai of the ninth month of year 12, a streaming star rose at mid-heaven; its head was like a jar and its tail like a two-hundred-hu boat, more than ten zhang long; it sounded like ducks in flight and shone like a torch; it passed below the moon and streamed westward; in a moment it struck the ground with a grinding roar, and three great sounds like collapsing houses rang out between Chen and Cai.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月己亥，有大流星出北斗魁，長二丈餘，南抵軒轅而滅。

translations.literal: On jihai of the fifth month of the fourteenth year, a large streaming star came forth from the head of the Northern Dipper, more than two zhang long, reached south to the Chariot and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the fifth month of year 14, a large streaming star came forth from the head of the Northern Dipper, more than two zhang long, reached south to the Chariot, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有赦，赦視星之大小。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be an amnesty; the amnesty is gauged by the star's size.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be an amnesty; the amnesty is gauged by the star's size.

sentences.zh: 」十五年七月癸亥，有大星出鉤陳，南流至婁滅。

translations.literal: " On guihai of the seventh month of the fifteenth year, a large star came forth from the Array of Hooks, streamed southward, and was extinguished at Lou.
translations.idiomatic: " On guihai of the seventh month of year 15, a large star came forth from the Array of Hooks, streamed southward, and vanished at Lou.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年正月丙辰，有大星出狼星北，色赤，有尾迹，長三丈餘，光燭地，東北流至七星南滅。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the first month of the first year of Changqing, a large star came forth north of the Wolf Star, red in color, with a tail-trail more than three zhang long, with light that lit the ground; it streamed northeast and was extinguished south of the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen of the first month of Changqing 1, a large star came forth north of the Wolf Star, red in color, with a tail-trail more than three zhang long, lighting the ground; it streamed northeast and vanished south of the Seven Stars.

sentences.zh: 四月，有大星墜于吳，聲如飛羽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, a large star fell in Wu, with a sound like flying feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, a large star fell in Wu with a sound like flying feathers.

sentences.zh: 七月乙巳，有大流星出參西北，色黃，有尾迹，長六七丈，光燭地，至羽林滅。

translations.literal: On yisi of the seventh month, a large streaming star came forth northwest of Shen, yellow in color, with a tail-trail six or seven zhang long, with light that lit the ground; it was extinguished at the Feathered Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi of the seventh month, a large streaming star came forth northwest of Shen, yellow in color, with a tail-trail six or seven zhang long, lighting the ground; it vanished at the Feathered Forest.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，東北方有大星自雲中出，色白，光燭地，前銳後大，長二丈餘，西北流入雲中滅。

translations.literal: On xinsi of the eighth month, in the northeast there was a large star that came forth from within the clouds, white in color, with light that lit the ground; sharp in front and large behind, more than two zhang long, it streamed northwest into the clouds and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the eighth month, in the northeast a large star emerged from the clouds, white in color, lighting the ground; sharp in front and broad behind, more than two zhang long, it streamed northwest into the clouds and vanished.

sentences.zh: 二年四月辛亥，有流星出天市，光燭地，隱隱有聲，至郎位滅。
