translations.literal: On xinhai of the fourth month of the second year, there was a streaming star that came forth from the Celestial Market, with light that lit the ground and a faint sound; it was extinguished at the Official's Stand.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai of the fourth month of year 2, a streaming star came forth from the Celestial Market, lighting the ground with a faint sound; it vanished at the Official's Stand.

sentences.zh: 市者，小人所聚，郎在天廷中，主宿衞。

translations.literal: The market is where petty men gather; the Officials are within the celestial court and govern the night watch.
translations.idiomatic: The market is where petty men gather; the Officials stand within the celestial court and govern the night watch.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，有小星隕于房、心間，戊戌亦如之，己亥亦如之。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the sixth month, small stars fell between Fang and Xin; on wuxu it was likewise, and on jihai likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the sixth month, small stars fell between the Fang and Xin lodges; on wuxu it was the same, and on jihai the same again.

sentences.zh: 閏十月丙申，有流星大如斗，抵中台上星。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the intercalary tenth month, there was a streaming star as large as a dipper that reached the upper star of the Middle Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the intercalary tenth month, a streaming star as large as a dipper reached the upper star of the Middle Terrace.

sentences.zh: 三年八月丁酉夜，有大流星如數斗器，起西北，經奎、婁，東南流，去月甚近，迸光散落，墜地有聲。

translations.literal: On the night of dingyou of the eighth month of the third year, there was a large streaming star like several dipper measures; it rose in the northwest, passed through Kui and Lou, and streamed southeast, very close to the moon; bursting light scattered, and when it struck the ground there was a sound.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingyou of the eighth month of year 3, a large streaming star like several dipper measures rose in the northwest, passed through Kui and Lou, and streamed southeast very close to the moon; bursting light scattered, and it struck the ground with a sound.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，紫微中，星隕者眾。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, many stars fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, many stars fell within the Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 七月乙卯，有大流星出天船，犯斗魁樞星而滅。

translations.literal: On yimao of the seventh month, a large streaming star came forth from the Celestial Boat, transgressed the pivot star of the Dipper's head, and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the seventh month, a large streaming star came forth from the Celestial Boat, transgressed the pivot star of the Dipper's head, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有舟楫事。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be matters of boats and oars.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be matters of boats and oars.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，有大流星出天將軍東北，入濁。

translations.literal: " On bingzi, a large streaming star came forth northeast of the Celestial General and entered the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi, a large streaming star came forth northeast of the Celestial General and entered the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 寶曆元年正月乙卯，有流星出北斗樞星，光燭地，入濁。

translations.literal: On yimao of the first month of the first year of Baoli, there was a streaming star that came forth from the pivot star of the Northern Dipper, with light that lit the ground, and entered the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the first month of Baoli 1, a streaming star came forth from the pivot star of the Northern Dipper, lighting the ground, and entered the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有赦。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 」二年五月癸巳，西北有流星，長三丈餘，光燭地，入天市中滅。

translations.literal: " On guisi of the fifth month of the second year, in the northwest there was a streaming star more than three zhang long, with light that lit the ground; it entered the Celestial Market and was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: " On guisi of the fifth month of year 2, a streaming star in the northwest, more than three zhang long, lit the ground as it entered the Celestial Market and vanished.

sentences.zh: 占為有誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication was for executions.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read as executions.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，日初入，東南有流星，向南滅，以晷度推之，箕、斗間。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the seventh month, as the sun first entered, in the southeast there was a streaming star that was extinguished southward; by gnomon measurement it was reckoned between Ji and Dou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu of the seventh month, as the sun first entered, a streaming star in the southeast vanished southward; by gnomon measurement it was placed between the Ji and Dou lodges.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，有大流星出王良，長四丈餘，至北斗杓滅。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the eighth month, a large streaming star came forth from Wang Liang, more than four zhang long, and was extinguished at the ladle of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen of the eighth month, a large streaming star came forth from Wang Liang, more than four zhang long, and vanished at the ladle of the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 王良，奉車御官也。

translations.literal: Wang Liang is the officer who attends the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Liang is the officer who attends the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 大和四年六月辛未，自昏至戊夜，流星或大或小，觀者不能數。

translations.literal: On xinwei of the sixth month of the fourth year of Dahe, from dusk until the fifth watch, streaming stars large and small appeared; observers could not count them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the sixth month of Dahe 4, from dusk until the fifth watch, streaming stars large and small appeared beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「民失其所，王者失道，綱紀廢則然。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "When the people lose their place, when the king loses the Way, and when statutes and ordinances are abandoned, it is thus.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When the people lose their place, when the king loses the Way, and when statutes and ordinances are abandoned, it is thus.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「星在野象物，在朝象官。

translations.literal: " It also says: "Stars in the wilds signify things; in the court they signify officials.
translations.idiomatic: " It also says: "Stars in the wilds signify things; in the court they signify officials.

sentences.zh: 」七年六月戊子，自昏及曙，四方流星，大小縱橫百餘。

translations.literal: " On wuzi of the sixth month of the seventh year, from dusk until dawn, streaming stars in all four directions, large and small, crisscrossing — more than a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuzi of the sixth month of year 7, from dusk until dawn, more than a hundred streaming stars large and small crisscrossed the four directions.

sentences.zh: 八年六月辛巳，夜中有流星出河鼓，赤色，有尾迹，光燭地，迸如散珠，北行近天棓滅，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On xinsi of the sixth month of the eighth year, in the middle of the night a streaming star came forth from the River Drum, red in color, with a tail-trail, with light that lit the ground, bursting like scattered pearls; it traveled northward, was extinguished near the Celestial Club, and had a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi of the sixth month of year 8, in the middle of the night a streaming star came forth from the River Drum, red in color, with a tail-trail lighting the ground and bursting like scattered pearls; it traveled northward, vanished near the Celestial Club, and sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 河鼓為將軍。

translations.literal: The River Drum signifies a general.
translations.idiomatic: The River Drum signifies a general.

sentences.zh: 天棓者，帝之武備。

translations.literal: The Celestial Club is the emperor's martial equipment.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Club is the emperor's martial equipment.

sentences.zh: 九年六月丁酉，自昏至丁夜，流星二十餘，縱橫出沒，多近天漢。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the sixth month of the ninth year, from dusk until the fourth watch, more than twenty streaming stars appeared and vanished crisscrossing, mostly near the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the sixth month of year 9, from dusk until the fourth watch, more than twenty streaming stars crisscrossed in and out of view, mostly near the Celestial River.

sentences.zh: 開成二年九月丁酉，有星大如斗，長五丈，自室、壁西北流，入大角下沒，行類枉矢，中天有聲，小星數百隨之。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the ninth month of the second year of Kaicheng, there was a star as large as a dipper, five zhang long, that streamed northwest from Shi and Bi, was extinguished below the Great Horn, moved like the Crooked Arrow, had a sound at mid-heaven, and hundreds of small stars followed it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the ninth month of Kaicheng 2, a star as large as a dipper, five zhang long, streamed northwest from Shi and Bi, vanished below the Great Horn, moved like the Crooked Arrow, sounded at mid-heaven, and hundreds of small stars followed it.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，有大星隕于興元府署寢室之上，光燭庭宇。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the eleventh month, a large star fell above the sleeping chamber of the Xingyuan prefectural headquarters; its light lit the courtyard buildings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou of the eleventh month, a large star fell above the sleeping chamber of the Xingyuan prefectural headquarters, lighting the courtyard buildings.

sentences.zh: 三年五月乙丑，有大星出于柳、張，尾長五丈餘，再出再沒。

translations.literal: On yichou of the fifth month of the third year, a large star came forth from Liu and Zhang, with a tail more than five zhang long; it came forth again and was extinguished again.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the fifth month of year 3, a large star came forth from Liu and Zhang with a tail more than five zhang long; it appeared again and vanished again.

sentences.zh: 四年二月己亥，丁夜至戊夜，四方中天流星小大凡二百餘，並西流，有尾迹，長二丈至五丈。

translations.literal: On jihai of the second month of the fourth year, from the fourth watch to the fifth watch, at mid-heaven in all four directions there were more than two hundred streaming stars large and small, all streaming westward, with tail-trails two to five zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the second month of year 4, from the fourth watch to the fifth watch, more than two hundred streaming stars large and small at mid-heaven in all four directions streamed westward, with tail-trails two to five zhang long.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，流星出羽林，有尾迹，長八丈餘，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On xinwei of the eighth month, a streaming star came forth from the Feathered Forest, with a tail-trail more than eight zhang long, and had a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the eighth month, a streaming star came forth from the Feathered Forest with a tail-trail more than eight zhang long and sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 羽林，天軍也。

translations.literal: The Feathered Forest is heaven's army.
translations.idiomatic: The Feathered Forest is heaven's army.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，蚩尤旗見。

translations.literal: On renshen of the twelfth month, the Banner of Chiyou appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the twelfth month, the Banner of Chiyou appeared.

sentences.zh: 會昌元年六月戊辰，自昏至戊夜，小星數十，縱橫流散。

translations.literal: On wuchen of the sixth month of the first year of Huichang, from dusk until the fifth watch, several tens of small stars streamed and scattered crisscrossing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the sixth month of Huichang 1, from dusk until the fifth watch, several tens of small stars streamed and scattered crisscrossing.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「小星，民象。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "Small stars are the omen of the people.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Small stars are the omen of the people.

sentences.zh: 」七月庚午，北方有星，光燭地，東北流經王良，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: " On gengwu of the seventh month, in the north there was a star with light that lit the ground; it streamed northeast past Wang Liang, with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengwu of the seventh month, a star in the north lit the ground as it streamed northeast past Wang Liang with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，有大星東北流，光燭地，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eleventh month, a large star streamed northeast, with light that lit the ground and a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the eleventh month, a large star streamed northeast, lighting the ground and sounding like thunder.

sentences.zh: 四年八月丙午，有大星如炬火，光燭天地，自奎、婁掃西方七宿而隕。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the eighth month of the fourth year, a large star like a torch flame, with light that lit heaven and earth, swept through the seven lodges of the western quarter from Kui and Lou and fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the eighth month of year 4, a large star like a torch flame lit heaven and earth as it swept through the seven lodges of the western quarter from Kui and Lou and fell.

sentences.zh: 六年二月辛丑，夜中有流星赤色如桃，光燭地，有尾迹，貫紫微入濁。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the second month of the sixth year, in the middle of the night there was a streaming star red like a peach, with light that lit the ground and a tail-trail; it pierced through the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and entered the Turbid.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou of the second month of year 6, in the middle of the night a streaming star red like a peach lit the ground with its tail-trail, pierced the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and entered the Turbid.

sentences.zh: 咸通六年七月乙酉，甲夜有大流星長數丈，光爍如電，羣小星隨之，自南徂北。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the seventh month of the sixth year of Xiantong, on the first night watch there was a large streaming star several zhang long, flashing like lightning, with a host of small stars following it from south to north.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou of the seventh month of Xiantong 6, on the first night watch a large streaming star several zhang long flashed like lightning, with a host of small stars following it from south to north.

sentences.zh: 其象南方有以眾叛而之北也。

translations.literal: Its omen was that in the south someone would rebel with a multitude and go north.
translations.idiomatic: The omen signified that in the south someone would rebel with a multitude and march north.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月丁酉，有星出如匹練，亙空化為雲而沒，在楚分。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the eleventh month of the ninth year, there was a star that came forth like a bolt of silk, spanning the sky, transformed into clouds and was extinguished; it was in the Chu allotment.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the eleventh month of year 9, a star came forth like a bolt of silk, spanning the sky, turned into clouds, and vanished; it was in the Chu allotment.

sentences.zh: 是謂長庚，見則兵起。

translations.literal: This is called Chang Geng; when it appears, warfare arises.
translations.idiomatic: This is called Chang Geng; when it appears, warfare arises.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，有二星從天際而上，相從至中天，狀如旌旗，乃隕。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year, two stars rose from the horizon upward, followed each other to mid-heaven, shaped like banners, and then fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 13, two stars rose from the horizon, followed each other to mid-heaven shaped like banners, and then fell.

sentences.zh: 九月，蚩尤旗見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the Banner of Chiyou appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the Banner of Chiyou appeared.

sentences.zh: 乾符二年冬，有二星，一赤一白，大如斗，相隨東南流，燭地如月，漸大，光芒猛怒。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year of Qianfu, there were two stars, one red and one white, as large as dippers, following each other streaming southeast, lighting the ground like the moon, gradually growing larger, with fierce, angry radiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of Qianfu 2, two stars, one red and one white and each as large as a dipper, followed each other streaming southeast, lighting the ground like the moon; they grew larger, their radiance fierce and angry.

sentences.zh: 三年，晝有星如炬火，大如五升器，出東北，徐行，隕于西北。

translations.literal: In the third year, in daylight there was a star like a torch flame, as large as a five-sheng vessel; it came forth in the northeast, traveled slowly, and fell in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, in daylight a star like a torch flame, as large as a five-sheng vessel, came forth in the northeast, traveled slowly, and fell in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，有大流星如盂，自虛、危，歷天市，入羽林滅，占為外兵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, a large streaming star like a bowl came from Xu and Wei, passed through the Celestial Market, and was extinguished in the Feathered Forest; the prognostication was for foreign troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 4, a large streaming star like a bowl came from the Xu and Wei lodges, passed through the Celestial Market, and vanished in the Feathered Forest; the omen was read as foreign troops.

sentences.zh: 中和元年，有異星出于輿鬼。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhonghe, an unusual star came forth from the Celestial Cart.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhonghe 1, an unusual star came forth from the Celestial Cart.

sentences.zh: 占者以為惡星。

translations.literal: The prognosticators held it to be an evil star.
translations.idiomatic: Prognosticators held it to be an evil star.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑夜，星隕如雨，或如杯椀者，交流如織，庚寅夜亦如之，至丁酉止。

translations.literal: On the night of jichou of the eighth month, stars fell like rain, some like cups and bowls, crossing and weaving like fabric; on the night of gengyin it was likewise, until dingyou when it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jichou of the eighth month, stars fell like rain, some like cups and bowls, crossing and weaving like fabric; on the night of gengyin it was the same, until dingyou when it ceased.

sentences.zh: 三年十一月夜，星隕于西北，如雨。

translations.literal: On the night of the eleventh month of the third year, stars fell in the northwest like rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the eleventh month of year 3, stars fell in the northwest like rain.

sentences.zh: 光啟二年九月，有大星隕于揚州府署延和閣前，聲如雷，光炎燭地。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Guangqi, a large star fell before the Yanhe Pavilion of the Yangzhou prefectural headquarters, with a sound like thunder and flames that lit the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Guangqi 2, a large star fell before the Yanhe Pavilion of the Yangzhou prefectural headquarters, sounding like thunder, its flames lighting the ground.

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌，有星出于西方，色白，長一丈五尺，屈曲而隕。

translations.literal: On renxu of the tenth month, a star came forth in the west, white in color, one zhang and five chi long, winding as it fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the tenth month, a star came forth in the west, white in color, one zhang and five chi long, winding as it fell.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「長庚也，下則流血。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "This is Chang Geng; when it descends, blood will flow.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This is Chang Geng; when it descends, blood will flow.

sentences.zh: 」三年五月，秦宗權擁兵于汴州北郊，晝有大星隕于其營，聲如雷，是謂營頭。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month of the third year, Qin Zongquan mustered troops at the northern suburbs of Bian Prefecture; in daylight a large star fell in his camp with a sound like thunder — this is called the Camp Head.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month of year 3, Qin Zongquan mustered troops at the northern suburbs of Bian; in daylight a large star fell in his camp with a sound like thunder — this is called the Camp Head.

sentences.zh: 其下破軍殺將。

translations.literal: Below it, armies were broken and generals killed.
translations.idiomatic: Below it, armies were broken and generals killed.

sentences.zh: 乾寧元年夏，有星隕于越州，後有光，長丈餘，狀如蛇。

translations.literal: In the summer of the first year of Qianning, a star fell in Yue Prefecture; afterward there was light more than a zhang long, shaped like a serpent.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Qianning 1, a star fell in Yue Prefecture; afterward light more than a zhang long rose, shaped like a serpent.

sentences.zh: 或曰枉矢也。

translations.literal: Some say it was the Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Some say it was the Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，天暴雨，雷電，有星大如椀，起西南，墜于東北，色如鶴練，聲如羣鴨飛。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, heaven poured violent rain with thunder and lightning; a star as large as a bowl rose in the southwest and fell in the northeast, colored like crane silk, with a sound like a flock of ducks in flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 3, heaven poured violent rain with thunder and lightning; a star as large as a bowl rose in the southwest and fell in the northeast, colored like crane silk and sounding like ducks in flight.

sentences.zh: 占為姦謀。

translations.literal: The prognostication was for treacherous plots.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read as treacherous plots.

sentences.zh: 光化元年九月丙子，有大星墜于北方。

translations.literal: On bingzi of the ninth month of the first year of Guanghua, a large star fell in the north.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the ninth month of Guanghua 1, a large star fell in the north.

sentences.zh: 三年三月丙午，有星如二十斛船，色黃，前銳後大，西南行。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the third month of the third year, there was a star like a twenty-hu boat, yellow in color, sharp in front and large behind, traveling southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu of the third month of year 3, a star like a twenty-hu boat, yellow in color, sharp in front and broad behind, traveled southwest.

sentences.zh: 十一月，中天有大星自東緩流如帶屈曲，光凝著天，食頃乃滅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, at mid-heaven a large star slowly streamed from the east like a bending belt; its light congealed upon heaven and only after the time of a meal was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, at mid-heaven a large star slowly streamed from the east like a bending belt; its light congealed upon the sky and only after the time of a meal did it vanish.

sentences.zh: 是謂枉矢。

translations.literal: This is called the Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: This is called the Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 天復三年二月，帝至自鳳翔，其明日，有大星如月，自東濁際西流，有聲如雷，尾跡橫貫中天，三夕乃滅。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of Tianfu, the emperor returned from Fengxiang; on the following day, a large star like the moon streamed westward from the turbid border in the east, with a sound like thunder; its tail-trail crossed the mid-heaven horizontally, and only after three nights was it extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tianfu 3, the emperor returned from Fengxiang; on the following day, a large star like the moon streamed westward from the turbid border in the east, sounding like thunder; its tail-trail crossed mid-heaven horizontally, and only after three nights did it vanish.

sentences.zh: 天祐元年五月戊寅，乙夜雨、晦暝，有星長二十丈，出東方，西南向，首黑、尾赤、中白，枉矢也，一曰長星。

translations.literal: On wuyin of the fifth month of the first year of Tianyou, on the second night watch with rain and obscured darkness, there was a star twenty zhang long that came forth in the east, facing southwest; black at the head, red at the tail, white in the middle — the Crooked Arrow, also called the Long Star.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin of the fifth month of Tianyou 1, on the second night watch with rain and obscured darkness, a star twenty zhang long came forth in the east, facing southwest; black at the head, red at the tail, white in the middle — the Crooked Arrow, also called the Long Star.

sentences.zh: 二年三月乙丑，夜中有大星出中天，如五斗器，流至西北，去地十丈許而止，上有星芒，炎如火，赤而黃，長丈五許，而蛇行，小星皆動而東南，其隕如雨，少頃沒，後有蒼白氣如竹叢，上衝天中，色瞢瞢。

translations.literal: On yichou of the third month of the second year, in the middle of the night a large star came forth at mid-heaven like a five-dipper measure, streamed to the northwest, and stopped about ten zhang from the ground; above it were star rays blazing like fire, red and yellow, about one zhang and five chi long, moving like a serpent; small stars all stirred and moved southeast; they fell like rain; in a little while they were extinguished; afterward there was pale blue vapor like bamboo thickets rushing up to mid-heaven, with a dim, hazy color.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou of the third month of year 2, in the middle of the night a large star came forth at mid-heaven like a five-dipper measure, streamed to the northwest, and stopped about ten zhang from the ground; above it star rays blazed like fire, red and yellow, about one zhang and five chi long, moving like a serpent; small stars all stirred and moved southeast; they fell like rain; in a little while they vanished; afterward pale blue vapor like bamboo thickets rushed up to mid-heaven, dim and hazy.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亦枉矢也。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "This is also the Crooked Arrow.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This is also the Crooked Arrow.

sentences.zh: 」三年十二月昏，東方有星如太白，自地徐上，行極緩，至中天，如上弦月，乃曲行，頃之，分為二。

translations.literal: " In the twilight of the twelfth month of the third year, in the east there was a star like Taibai that slowly rose from the ground, traveling very slowly; at mid-heaven it was like a first-quarter moon, then curved in its course; in a moment it divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twilight of the twelfth month of year 3, in the east a star like Taibai slowly rose from the ground, traveling very slowly; at mid-heaven it was like a first-quarter moon, then curved in its course; in a moment it divided into two.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有大孽。

translations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a great calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be a great calamity.
